name: claude-notify
description: Tells you when a Claude Code session finished and when one is waiting for you. Clicking the notification brings that session's tab to the front.

commands.title: Claude Notify: Send a test notification
Claude Notify: Check that notifications work
Claude Notify: Turn notifications on or off

claudeNotify.enabled.description: Announce sessions that finish or start waiting for you.

claudeNotify.minTurnSeconds.description: A turn shorter than this finishes quietly — you were watching it. 0 announces every turn.

claudeNotify.events.description: Which events are worth a notification.

claudeNotify.style.description: How long a notification stays on screen.

claudeNotify.sound.description: Play a sound with the notification.

claudeNotify.statusBar.description: Show running and waiting sessions in the status bar.
